ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which part of the diagram represents the Superior Lobes?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a colored schematic diagram of the lobes of the lungs. The upper regions of both lungs are colored light pink; in the legend in the upper right corner, the light pink square corresponds to the letter G, purple corresponds to B, and blue corresponds to A. Reasoning: The question asks about Superior Lobes, that is, “upper lobes/upper lung lobes.” Because superior means upper or top, the light pink region at the upper part of the lungs should be selected; the legend shows that light pink corresponds to G. Therefore the answer is G.
